leo_csm: Proposed checklist:

- T+0..60m: monitor P95 latency, error-rate, kv-hit-rate. Capture failure snippets.

ian_tse: Prefill payload (minimal):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"novalabs","sequences":[{"prompt":"welcome_1","count":3},{"prompt":"slot_test","count":3}],"cache_policy":"prefix","target_warmpool":"nova-warm"}'
```
Notes: stagger requests with 200-500ms jitter; tag requests with "cs-prefill-v1". If 24h CSAT <=5 or unique failing prompts >=3 tag "renewal-watch".
